title: Claude's Managed Agents now fetch only a URL that already appeared in the session
source_used: Anthropic API release notes (platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview), as MIXED Reality News returned a Cloudflare block (HTTP 403)
key_facts: In Claude Managed Agents, the web_fetch tool now fetches only URLs that have already appeared in the session, for example in a user message, a web_search result or a page web_fetch returned earlier.
Anthropic says this reduces the risk of data exfiltration.
A URL that appears only in Claude's own output, the agent's system prompt, an attached document or the output of a tool such as bash, read or an MCP tool does not count.
A web_fetch call for such a URL returns a url_not_in_prior_context error result to the agent.
To let the agent fetch a URL, send it in the text of a user.message event.
The release note sits under 7 Oct 2026 in Anthropic's notes, alongside a change that applies allowed_hosts to web_search and web_fetch in limited-networking environments.
quote_evidence: In Claude Managed Agents, the web_fetch tool now fetches only URLs that have already appeared in the session, for example in the text of a user message, in a web_search result, or in a page that web_fetch returned earlier.
This reduces the risk of data exfiltration.
To let the agent fetch a URL, send it in the text of a user.message event.
why_it_matters_hint: Developers building agents must now supply page addresses in a user message; Anthropic says it lowers data-exfiltration risk.
notes: MIXED Reality News blocked (403); text read from Anthropic's own release notes, the first source. Change dated 7 Oct 2026 in the notes, before the 9 Oct window, so score lowered by 1.
